units.source_text: 有些飞蛾，看起来老贴在纱窗上，其实是已经死掉了。

en.t: Some moths looked as if they were always clinging to the screen window, but in fact they were already dead.

units.source_text: 有的像枯叶似地飘散，也有的打墙壁上落下来。

en.t: Some fluttered away like dead leaves, and others fell down from the wall.

units.source_text: 岛村把它们拿到手上，心想：为什么会长得这样的美呢!

en.t: Shimamura picked them up in his hand and wondered why they had been made so beautiful.
